d: Long, wavy platinum white hair with thick bangs and flowing locks frames a youthful, adolescent face with wide, pale lavender eyes. The slender build is dressed in a white high-waisted dress with a gold-trimmed navy blue hem, layered under a navy blue capelet with gold accents and a matching navy blue high-collar. Dark navy blue lace-up boots reach the knees, and a golden star ornament sits at the throat. The character holds a blue glowing crystal sphere encased in a gold orbital cage.
